rules.hunger: food meter 0..1; drains to 0 in ~33 min (2000 s). Eating adds item.fill. Below 0.30 you get the hungry hint and up to 5% slower sprint. Never kills.
rules.hearts: HEALTH.hp max 20 = 10 hearts; item.hp is in half-hearts (hp 6 = +3 hearts).
rules.warmth: meter 0..1, drains in ~30 min outdoors (faster in snow and at night). New: drain x (1 - 0.8 x sum of worn warm_resist). Max sum 1.0. Hot drinks add item.warm.
rules.eat_use: Hold in hotbar + click (0.6 s bite) or USE in inventory. If hunger > 0.95 and hearts full: "You are full", not consumed. Multi-use items (brunost 3, julekake 2) drop one use per bite.
rules.buy: canFit(id,n) before paying; if full: no charge + "Your pockets are full. Throw something away at a bin (nearest: N m)". Pickups/chests that do not fit drop a bag at your feet. Nothing is ever lost.
rules.stack: food 16 (meals 4, pizza/burger), drinks 8, thermos 4, ammo 16, rocket_m 8, blocks 64, wearables/tools 1.
rules.quest_items: flare, rocket*, snowball, string, thermos, julekule: cannot be binned while an active quest asks for them.
rules.battery: use = flashlight 100% (10 min). No free idle recharge. Lamps and flares keep their slow recharge.
rules.axe: th_axe left-click on a tree fells it. No axe: "You need an axe." Hands still break blocks.
rules.blocks: right-click places the held block item, left-click breaks it. Breaking drops only the block itself.
rules.trash: Stand within 3 m of a bin, press G (tap the prompt): inventory opens with a TRASH slot; drag/tap item -> TRASH; confirm if stack value >= 100 kr.
